# security-openbao-follow-namespace

<!-- END DECLARED -->

## Notes

A `ReplacementTransformer`, referenced under `transformers:` (not `components:`)
in the overlay that sets `namespace:`. It copies the namespace of ServiceAccount
`openbao` into the subject of ClusterRoleBinding `openbao-auth-delegator` and into
the host of the ClusterSecretStore `server:`, two values `namespace:` does not touch.

It cannot be a Component: Components run before their consumer's own
`namespace:`, so it would still read `security` (verified by build). An overlay
further up that changes the namespace again needs the line too. Without
`namespace:` it is a no-op.
